notes.title: New Hovercraft and Weapons
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Assemblers!
Amongst a dozen other things I've been working on over the past two weeks I would like to show off some the new vehicles and weapons that have been added to the game.

Let me introduce you to the new hovercraft: Hopper, Spatha, Phantom, Striker and Cleaver.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/331e8dd8cf43d1f793609b08992fb9724df447f3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/999adbe35f0b0e03f9484948d33c9a0097449f20.png
Remember, these are just the base hovercraft hulls - You decide which hoverpads, weaponry and extra utility they bring to the field for your faction!

User Interface Work
After receiving some criticism for my original in-game user interface panel I experimented with an alternative design approach:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/297d7bfa4db512c64e546c3614cee9af9922c2b1.png
Feedback
After asking for feedback on the user interface panels, the previous design was the clear winner.
Take a look, it now features new icons for all kinds of different vehicles:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/e0986911069c19032626dd0bd1cf73e293395d58.png
Join our Discord Server!

notes.title: Customization Screen Progress
notes.content:
This week I've been working on the vehicle customization screen in the assembly.

The assembly is a workshop where you will be able to set up your faction to your liking and preferences, including vehicles, infantry, aircraft and mechs.

Lighting the Assembly
To make the assembly look as good as possible I experimented with different lighting setups and volumetric fog.

My hope was that the volumetric fog would look like smoke filling the workshop.
Although it had a great visual effect on the scene it also reduced visual clarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/78fb1d2083b2774a010b9586326aa58b4d34bb98.png
In theory I could have created a shader to achieve the desired effect.
Instead I decided to ditch the idea completely.

Once I removed the fog and improved the lighting even further I focused on creating the user interface.
I even experimented with having a 3D representation of the vehicle operator selected to the right.

The Assembly User Interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/5600dd0dda32687e41ad4d8dc119f95ebb105a5e.png
Down below you can see what the vehicle customization screen looks like right now.
The UI isn't finished and you can't select different components yet.

I've made a separate icon for each damage type:
Grenade, Rocket, Cannon, Bullet and Sniper.

One of these icons is displayed for each of the armor's weaknesses.
For example, the Billhook hull has a weakness against explosive, rocket and bullet damage and cannon damage especially.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/a2d121f18028d50f9aa754d6fb02c0ea237d4635.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43621037/797ea6bd038ab9ed560a27716d1289453bb91f49.gif
This is just the beginning, but it should give a good idea of what to expect from the assembly in the future.

If you're excited for this one-of-a-kind real-time strategy game, why not share the news with your strategy friends? Thank you for being a supporter of Assembly RTS.

Remember, you can always join our Discord server to discuss this game's future in a friendly forum setting, together with other strategy game enthusiasts. I hope to see you there!
